title: Legal Notice for Wrongful Termination, Non-Payment of Salary, and Full and Final Settlement
whenToUse: Use when an employee has been wrongfully or abruptly terminated without notice pay, statutory dues, earned wages, or gratuity settlement.
variantComparisonNote: Pre-litigation legal notice by employee's advocate. Distinct from formal claim petition before Labour Commissioner or Industrial Tribunal.
youWillNeed: Offer letter, employment contract, salary slips, termination email, bank account statements proving non-credit.
legalBasis: Payment of Wages Act, 1936; Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972; Section 73 Indian Contract Act, 1872; Industrial Disputes Act, 1947.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Details of employment tenure, designation, and last drawn monthly salary
Breach of contractual notice period or unlawful summary termination
Itemized ledger of unpaid salary, notice pay, gratuity, and leave encashment
Peremptory 15-day demand before initiating labour court / civil action

particulars.label: Total Claim Dues (INR)
particulars.description: Aggregate unpaid wages and settlement sum

aiBlocks.title: Employment History & Breach of Contract
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate employment history of {{FACT:employee_name}} as {{FACT:designation}}, exemplary service record, and sudden unlawful termination in breach of employment covenants.

aiBlocks.title: Itemized Computation of Terminal Dues
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Provide itemized computation totaling ₹{{FACT:total_dues_amount}}/- covering unpaid salary, severance notice pay, gratuity, and accrued leave encashment.

aiBlocks.title: Peremptory Demand & Legal Repercussions
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Call upon company to remit total settlement within 15 days, failing which proceedings under Payment of Wages Act, Gratuity Act, and civil recovery suit will be initiated with 18% interest.
